name: doc-book-reader
description: 书本式项目文档阅读器：翻页、跳转、细节折叠、标记与备注持久化

scripts.dev:agent: AGENT_ENABLED=1 concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green npm:dev:server npm:dev:client
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
